facts.command:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s:%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 16.04
systemctl is-active mysql

facts.observation:
audit_events	InnoDB
customers	InnoDB
orders	InnoDB
order_items	InnoDB
audit_events	event_id	bigint(20) unsigned	NO	PRI
audit_events	entity_type	varchar(32)	NO	MUL
audit_events	entity_id	bigint(20) unsigned	NO	
audit_events	action	varchar(32)	NO	
audit_events	event_time	datetime	NO	
audit_events	details	varchar(255)	NO	
customers	customer_id	int(10) unsigned	NO	PRI
customers	external_ref	varchar(32)	NO	UNI
customers	full_name	varchar(120)	NO	
customers	email	varchar(160)	NO	UNI
customers	status	enum('active','paused','closed')	NO	
customers	created_at	datetime	NO	
orders	order_id	bigint(20) unsigned	NO	PRI
orders	customer_id	int(10) unsigned	NO	MUL
orders	order_ref	varchar(32)	NO	UNI
orders	total_cents	int(10) unsigned	NO	
orders	status	enum('pending','paid','shipped','cancelled')	NO	
orders	created_at	datetime	NO	
order_items	order_id	bigint(20) unsigned	NO	PRI
order_items	line_no	smallint(5) unsigned	NO	PRI
order_items	sku	varchar(40)	NO	
order_items	quantity	smallint(5) unsigned	NO	
order_items	unit_price_cents	int(10) unsigned	NO
facts.command:
set -eu
sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT TABLE_NAME, ENGINE FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME; SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_KEY FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION;"

set -eu
for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do
  printf '%s ' "$table"
  sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $table"
done

set -eu
digest() {
  table="$1"
  sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names legacy_shop -e "SELECT * FROM $table" | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
}
for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do
  printf '%s ' "$table"
  digest "$table"
done

facts.observation:
active
enabled
10.0.38-MariaDB-0ubuntu0.16.04.1	/var/lib/mysql/	utf8mb4	utf8mb4_general_ci
mysql.service is not a native service, redirecting to systemd-sysv-install
Executing /lib/systemd/systemd-sysv-install is-enabled mysql

systemctl is-active mysql

sudo -n mysql --batch --skip-column-names -e "SELECT @@version, @@datadir, @@character_set_server, @@collation_server"
